macros.name: AtNextSelectfont
macros.doc: \AtNextSelectfont{⟨code⟩} declares ⟨code⟩ that is saved internally and executed just after and only the next \selectfont.

macros.name: EverySelectfont
macros.doc: \EverySelectfont{⟨code⟩} declares ⟨code⟩ that is saved internally and executed just after each \selectfont.
